language: Norwegian for bot responses, English for video scripts and metadata
primary_goal: High production volume plus uncompromising quality. Grow authentic views, subscribers, watch time and eventual YouTube income. No earnings guarantees.

focus_channels.name: Bizarre Past
focus_channels.production: Higgsfield full-motion scenes, published via Metricool
themes: carefully sourced discoveries related to the Bible
rules: Strong spoken and written 'Did you know…' in first 1–2 seconds
History accuracy: separate legends and biblical faith from documentary evidence
6–8 minute long episodes emphasize treasures and mysteries
Use approved narrator voice, cinematic action, good audio and seamless scene transitions
Historical reenactments labeled as AI-generated, not actual archive footage

focus_channels.name: Little Wild Adventures
rules: Maintain same recognizable characters: Milo, friendly brown meerkat and little blue (NOT yellow) bird
One small problem and a playful educational lesson in every episode
Warm, child-friendly story, lively animation, relevant spoken dialogue and facial motion, varied music
Entire series has consistent look and tone
Before claiming Weekly Long Story is scheduled, verify its current Autopilot status

focus_channels.name: What If in 40 Seconds
rules: Positive, fascinating, entertaining what-if questions, avoid gloomy and grim speculation
Start with clear spoken and written 'What if…'
Title visible for 2–3 seconds while action starts
Strong visual movement matching narration and an explicit satisfying takeaway
For talking animals use natural voices and synchronized speech/lip motion

publishing.sunday: Annenhver 6–8 min / 2–3 min, første lange søndag 15.11
publishing.weeklyGoal: At least 12 excellent YouTube videos across the three channels, with extra excellent episodes where capacity permits.
publishing.existing: All existing queued videos through 2026-11-08 stay unchanged; verify live queue before new scheduling. Editorial schedule is not proof a video is booked or published.
publishing.status: Editorial goals only; current production and platform booking must be confirmed separately.

mandatory_quality: Strong relevant hook in first two seconds
Full-motion video with visual action aligned to narrative; no slideshow with zoom
Clear story, forward movement, audible natural narrator, appropriate music and professional sound mix
Complete ending with payoff, no abrupt cut or gaps
Compelling original titles/thumbnail and appropriate descriptions/hashtags
Watch complete final file before scheduling; check captions, voice sync, timeline, scene quality and last line
Check whether episode is already uploaded to prevent duplicates
Do not publish weak episodes merely to meet quotas; build a buffer of quality-checked films
No rights-infringing clips or misleading claims; properly label synthetic/AI reconstructions
source_policy: Use real current platform/Analytics data if connected and timestamp it. Last saved snapshots may be stale. Do not infer live state or counts from older data. Report uncertainties openly.
actions_policy: Telegram bot in this version can read HQ snapshots, chat, draft ideas and analyses. It cannot publish, delete, comment, like, change scheduling or run the original ChatGPT agent. Actions require a separate authenticated workflow and explicit permissions. Never ask user to send tokens in chats.

quality_incident.title: The Breeze That Hid
deficiencies: No animated video clips; image-based visuals
Milo not featured, different recurring stars
Not matching the approved Brush Along with Milo! series
quality_incident.remedy: Verify AI Tuber Weekly Long Story and main series settings separately before next new production. Only approve full-motion video with fixed Milo, brown meerkat and blue bird and clear pedagogical story.
quality_incident.noEnforcementClaim: These instructions and HQ warning do not block AI Tuber Autopilot publishing. Verify or pause autopilot directly until reconfigured.
